name: Multidrop Combi — Production Readiness Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test checklist for validating the Multidrop Combi SiLA 2 server prior to production deployment. Covers communication, parameter validation, command sequencing, error recovery, and physical hardware tests. Tests can be run in Simulation mode (no hardware) or Real mode (requires instrument).

categories.name: Communication & Connection
categories.description: Serial port connection, buffer handling, reconnection robustness

tests.name: Connect in simulation mode
tests.description: Connect to the simulated instrument. Verifies Connect succeeds and returns simulated instrument info.

tests.name: Connect to real instrument
tests.description: Connect to the instrument via serial port. Verifies VER command succeeds and returns instrument name, firmware version, and serial number.

tests.name: Connect with invalid serial port
tests.description: Attempt to connect with a non-existent serial port. Should return a CommunicationError, not crash.

tests.name: Disconnect cleanly (sim)
tests.description: Disconnect from the simulated instrument.

tests.name: Disconnect cleanly (real)
tests.description: Disconnect from the instrument. Verifies QIT is sent and port is closed.

tests.name: Reconnect after disconnect (sim)
tests.description: Disconnect then immediately reconnect in simulation mode.

tests.name: Reconnect after disconnect (real)
tests.description: Disconnect then immediately reconnect. Tests that stale serial buffer data is drained properly and VER succeeds on the second connection.
tests.expected: Second connect succeeds without status 3 errors

tests.name: Rapid disconnect/reconnect cycle x5 (sim)
tests.description: Rapidly disconnect and reconnect 5 times in succession in simulation mode.

tests.name: Rapid disconnect/reconnect cycle x5 (real)
tests.description: Rapidly disconnect and reconnect 5 times in succession. Stress-tests buffer drain logic and serial port handling.

tests.name: Disconnect when already disconnected
tests.description: Call Disconnect when not connected. Should not error.

tests.name: Command while disconnected
tests.description: Send a command (SetPlateType) while not connected. Should return NotConnected error.

categories.name: Simulation Mode Switching
categories.description: SimulationController mode switching and observable property updates

tests.name: Enter simulation mode
tests.description: Switch to simulation mode via SimulationController. Verify SimulationMode observable updates.

tests.name: Exit simulation mode
tests.description: Switch to real mode via SimulationController.

tests.name: Mode switch disconnects instrument
tests.description: Connect in simulation, then switch to real mode. Verify instrument is disconnected automatically.
tests.expected: After mode switch, IsConnected is false

categories.name: Parameter Validation
categories.description: Verify all command parameters are validated against manual specs before reaching the instrument

tests.name: SetPlateType valid range 0-9 (sim)
tests.description: Set plate types 0 through 9 (factory-defined) in simulation mode. All should succeed.

tests.name: SetPlateType valid range 0-9 (real)
tests.description: Set plate types 0 through 9 (factory-defined) on real instrument. All should succeed.

tests.name: SetPlateType out of range (30)
tests.description: Set plate type to 30 (out of range). Should be rejected by FDL constraint validation.

tests.name: SetCassetteType factory types 0-1 (sim)
tests.description: Set cassette types 0 (Standard Tube) and 1 (Small Tube) in simulation. Types 2-3 are user-defined and may not be configured.

tests.name: SetCassetteType factory types 0-1 (real)
tests.description: Set cassette types 0 (Standard Tube) and 1 (Small Tube) on real instrument. Types 2-3 are user-defined and may not exist.

tests.name: SetCassetteType out of range (4)
tests.description: Set cassette type to 4 (out of range). Should be rejected.

tests.name: SetColumnVolume volume 0 — clear column (sim)
tests.description: Set column volume to 0 (do not dispense) in simulation. Should be accepted.

tests.name: SetColumnVolume volume 0 — clear column (real)
tests.description: Set column volume to 0 (do not dispense) on real instrument. Should be accepted.

tests.name: SetColumnVolume max volume (25000)
tests.description: Set column volume to 25000 (2500 uL max). Should be accepted.

tests.name: SetColumnVolume over max (25001)
tests.description: Set column volume to 25001 (over max). Should be rejected by FDL constraint.

tests.name: SetDispensingHeight valid 1700/17mm (sim)
tests.description: Set dispensing height to 1700 (17mm) in simulation. Should succeed.

tests.name: SetDispensingHeight valid 1700/17mm (real)
tests.description: Set dispensing height to 1700 (17mm) on real instrument. Should succeed.

tests.name: SetDispensingHeight below min (499)
tests.description: Set dispensing height to 499 (below 500 min). Should be rejected.

tests.name: SetDispensingHeight above max (5501)
tests.description: Set dispensing height to 5501 (above 5500 max). Should be rejected.

tests.name: SetPumpSpeed valid range 1, 50, 100 (sim)
tests.description: Set pump speed to 1%, 50%, and 100% in simulation. All should succeed.

tests.name: SetPumpSpeed valid range 1, 50, 100 (real)
tests.description: Set pump speed to 1%, 50%, and 100% on real instrument. All should succeed.

tests.name: SetPumpSpeed out of range (0, 101)
tests.description: Set pump speed to 0 and 101. Both should be rejected.

tests.name: Shake invalid distance/speed combo
tests.description: Shake with distance=5mm at speed=20Hz. Per manual, max distance at 20Hz is 1mm. Should be rejected by FDL constraint or server validation.

categories.name: Command Sequencing & Error States
categories.description: Verify correct behavior for command ordering, prerequisites, and error state handling

tests.name: Dispense without priming (sim)
tests.description: Attempt to dispense without priming first in simulation. Should return NotPrimed error.

tests.name: Dispense without priming (real)
tests.description: Attempt to dispense without priming first on real instrument. Instrument should return error 14 (pump not primed).
tests.expected: InstrumentError: Cannot dispense when pump not primed (error 14)

tests.name: Dispense with all volumes = 0 (sim)
tests.description: Set all column volumes to 0, then attempt to dispense in simulation.

tests.name: Dispense with all volumes = 0 (real)
tests.description: Set all column volumes to 0, then attempt to dispense. Instrument should return error 17.
tests.expected: InstrumentError: Dispense volume for all columns is 0 (error 17)

tests.name: AcknowledgeError clears error state (sim)
tests.description: Trigger an error, then send AcknowledgeError, then verify a normal command works again in simulation.
tests.expected: After EAK, commands resume normal operation

tests.name: AcknowledgeError clears error state (real)
tests.description: Trigger an error (e.g., dispense without prime), then send AcknowledgeError, then verify a normal command works again.
tests.expected: After EAK, commands resume normal operation

tests.name: MoveOut command (sim)
tests.description: Send MoveOut (POU) command in simulation.

tests.name: MoveOut command (real)
tests.description: Send MoveOut (POU) command. Plate carrier should move to loading position.
tests.expected: Command succeeds, plate carrier moves out

tests.name: Restart instrument (real)
tests.description: Send Restart (RST) command. Instrument should reboot. Requires reconnect afterward.

tests.name: Abort during dispense
tests.description: Set up and start a dispense, then abort it mid-operation.
tests.expected: Dispense stops, instrument returns to idle state, no error state persists

steps.message: Place a plate on the deck. After clicking Continue, a dispense will start. Open the WebUI in another tab and click Abort while the dispense is running.
Did the dispense stop when you clicked Abort? Is the instrument back in idle state with no persistent error?
steps.fail_label: No, error persists or did not stop

tests.name: Abort during shake
tests.description: Start a long shake, then abort it mid-operation.
tests.expected: Shake stops, plate carrier returns to normal position

steps.message: Place a plate on the deck. After clicking Continue, a 30-second shake will start. Open the WebUI in another tab and click Abort while shaking.
Did the shake stop when you clicked Abort? Has the plate carrier returned to its normal position?
steps.fail_label: No, still shaking or plate shifted

categories.name: Prime & Empty Operations
categories.description: Verify prime and empty commands with standard and continuous modes

tests.name: Standard prime — fixed volume (sim)
tests.description: Prime in simulation mode with standard volume. Verifies command flow and IsPrimed state change.

tests.name: Standard prime — fixed volume (real)
tests.description: Prime the instrument with a standard volume (50 uL).
tests.expected: Pump runs for set volume, then stops. IsPrimed becomes true.

steps.message: Ensure the priming vessel is in place and the hoses are submerged in liquid
Did the pump run and stop after dispensing the set volume?
steps.fail_label: No, pump did not behave as expected

tests.name: Continuous prime start/stop (sim)
tests.description: Start continuous prime in simulation, then stop it.

tests.name: Continuous prime start/stop (real)
tests.description: Start continuous prime, verify the pump is running, then stop it.
tests.expected: Pump starts on continuous prime, stops on standard prime

steps.message: Ensure the priming vessel is in place and the hoses are submerged in liquid
Is the pump running continuously?
Did the pump stop?

tests.name: Standard empty — fixed volume (sim)
tests.description: Empty in simulation mode with standard volume.

tests.name: Standard empty — fixed volume (real)
tests.description: Empty the hoses with a standard volume (50 uL).
tests.expected: Pump reverses for set volume, then stops

steps.message: Place an empty container to catch the emptied liquid
Did the pump run in reverse and stop after the set volume?

tests.name: Continuous empty start/stop (real)
tests.description: Prime first, then start continuous empty, verify the pump reverses, then stop it.
tests.expected: Pump starts reverse on continuous empty, stops on standard empty

steps.message: Place an empty container to catch the emptied liquid
Is the pump running in reverse continuously?
Did the pump stop?

categories.name: Dispense Operations
categories.description: Full dispense workflow tests with various plate and volume configurations

tests.name: Full dispense workflow (sim)
tests.description: Run a complete dispense workflow in simulation: set plate, cassette, height, columns, prime, dispense.

tests.name: Selective column dispense (sim)
tests.description: Set specific columns (1, 3, 5) with volume and clear others. Verifies SCV 0 0 clears all, then specific columns are set.
tests.expected: Commands succeed, only selected columns have volume

tests.name: 96-well plate — all columns same volume (real)
tests.description: Dispense to a 96-well plate with all columns at 50 uL.
tests.expected: All 96 wells filled with ~50 uL each

steps.message: Place an empty 96-well plate on the instrument deck
Are all 96 wells filled evenly?

tests.name: 96-well plate — selective columns (real)
tests.description: Dispense to columns 1, 3, 5 only on a 96-well plate at 100 uL.
tests.expected: Only columns 1, 3, 5 are dispensed. Columns 2, 4, 6-12 are empty.

steps.message: Place an empty 96-well plate on the instrument deck
Do ONLY columns 1, 3, 5 have liquid? Are columns 2, 4, 6-12 empty?

tests.name: 384-well plate dispense (real)
tests.description: Dispense to a 384-well plate with small tube cassette at 10 uL.
tests.expected: All 384 wells filled. Intermediate responses show column/row progress.

steps.message: Install the small tube cassette and place an empty 384-well plate on the deck
Are all 384 wells filled?

tests.name: Variable volumes per column (real)
tests.description: Dispense with different volumes per column (20, 50, 100 uL) to verify visual gradient.
tests.expected: Column 1 < Column 2 < Column 3 in fill level

steps.message: Place an empty 96-well plate on the instrument deck
Do the fill levels increase visually from column 1 to column 3? (20 < 50 < 100 uL)

tests.name: Dispensing height variation (real)
tests.description: Dispense at three different heights and compare splash/accuracy.
tests.expected: Lower height = less splash, more accurate. Very high height may cause more splash.

steps.message: Place an empty 96-well plate on the deck. Dispensing at STANDARD height (17mm).
Note the fill quality at 17mm. Was dispensing accurate with minimal splash?
Place a NEW empty 96-well plate on the deck. Dispensing at LOW height (10mm).
At 10mm height, was dispensing more accurate with less splash compared to 17mm?
Place a NEW empty 96-well plate on the deck. Dispensing at HIGH height (40mm).
At 40mm height, was there more splash/less accuracy compared to the lower heights?

categories.name: LockController
categories.description: Server locking for exclusive access control

tests.name: Lock and unlock server
tests.description: Lock the server with a token, then unlock it.

tests.name: Lock when already locked
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to lock again with a different token.
tests.expected: Second lock attempt returns ServerAlreadyLocked error

tests.name: Unlock with wrong token
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to unlock with a different token.

categories.name: Physical & Hardware Tests
categories.description: Tests requiring physical interaction with the instrument. The test runner automates setup and commands while prompting the user for physical actions.

tests.name: Remove priming vessel during prime
tests.description: Start a continuous prime, then remove the priming vessel to trigger an error.
tests.expected: Instrument reports error 15 (Missing prime vessel). Server translates to InstrumentError.

steps.message: Ensure the priming vessel is in place. After clicking Continue, a continuous prime will start. While the pump is running, REMOVE the priming vessel from its slot.
Did the instrument report an error (error 15 — Missing prime vessel)?

tests.name: Remove rotor shield during dispense
tests.description: Start a dispense, then remove the rotor shield to trigger an error.
tests.expected: Instrument reports error 16 (Rotor shield not in place). Dispense stops.

steps.message: Place a plate on the deck. After clicking Continue, a dispense will start. While dispensing, SLIDE THE ROTOR COVER out of place.
Did the instrument report error 16 (Rotor shield not in place) and stop dispensing?

tests.name: Press STOP on instrument keypad
tests.description: Start a long shake, then press the physical STOP button on the instrument.
tests.expected: Operation stops. The server detects the abort and updates status accordingly.

steps.message: After clicking Continue, a 30-second shake will start. While shaking, press the STOP button on the instrument's physical keypad.
Did the shake stop when you pressed STOP? Did the server handle the abort gracefully (no persistent error state)?

tests.name: USB cable disconnect during operation
tests.description: Start a continuous prime, disconnect the USB cable, then reconnect.
tests.expected: Server detects communication timeout, reports CommunicationError. After reconnecting cable, Connect succeeds.

steps.message: After clicking Continue, a continuous prime will start. While the pump is running, UNPLUG THE USB CABLE.
Did the server report a CommunicationError (timeout)?
Plug the USB cable back in and wait a few seconds for the OS to recognize the device.
Did the reconnect succeed?

tests.name: Power cycle instrument during remote control
tests.description: Connect, power off the instrument, observe the error, then power on and reconnect.
tests.expected: Next command fails with CommunicationError (timeout). After power-on, Connect succeeds.

steps.message: TURN OFF the instrument power switch now.
Did the command fail with a CommunicationError (timeout)?
TURN ON the instrument and wait for it to fully initialize (~15 seconds).
Did the reconnect succeed after power cycle?

tests.name: Swap cassette types
tests.description: Test dispensing with standard cassette, swap to small tube, then dispense again.
tests.expected: Correct cassette type setting works. Wrong cassette type may produce error 43.

steps.message: Ensure the STANDARD TUBE cassette is installed.
Place a plate on the deck.
Did the dispense with standard tube cassette succeed?
Physically SWAP to the SMALL TUBE cassette now.
Place a new plate on the deck.
Did the dispense with small tube cassette succeed?

tests.name: Shake — plate retention
tests.description: Shake at low and high speeds to verify plate retention.
tests.expected: Plate remains securely clamped during all shake operations

steps.message: Place a plate on the carrier and ensure it is properly seated.
At low speed (5 Hz), did the plate stay secure?
At high speed (15 Hz), did the plate stay secure?

categories.name: WebUI Integration
categories.description: Tests for the React WebUI, SSE streaming, and user interface correctness

tests.name: SSE connection indicator (sim)
tests.description: Verify the SSE LIVE/OFF badge by running commands and observing the WebUI.
tests.expected: Badge shows LIVE, observable properties update in real-time

steps.message: Open the Multidrop Combi WebUI in your browser. Verify that the 'SSE LIVE' badge is visible (green).
Is the SSE LIVE badge visible and green?
Did the WebUI update to show the instrument as connected?
Did the WebUI reset to show the instrument as disconnected?

tests.name: SSE connection indicator (real)
tests.description: Verify the SSE LIVE/OFF badge with real instrument connection.
tests.expected: Badge accurately reflects SSE connection state

steps.message: Open the Multidrop Combi WebUI in your browser. Verify the 'SSE LIVE' badge is visible (green).
Is the SSE LIVE badge visible and green?
Did the WebUI update to show the instrument as connected with real-time status?

tests.name: Observable property updates (sim)
tests.description: Run commands and verify that observable properties update in the WebUI within 1 second.
tests.expected: All status changes appear within 1 second in the WebUI

steps.message: Open the Multidrop Combi WebUI in your browser and watch for status updates as commands run.
Did the WebUI show IsConnected = true within 1 second?
Did the WebUI show PlateType = 384-well within 1 second?
Did the WebUI show IsPrimed = true within 1 second?
Did all status fields reset within 1 second after disconnect?

tests.name: Observable property updates (real)
tests.description: Run commands on real instrument and verify WebUI updates within 1 second.
tests.expected: All status changes appear within 1 second in the WebUI

steps.message: Open the Multidrop Combi WebUI in your browser and watch for status updates as commands run.
Did the WebUI show IsConnected = true within 1 second?
Did the WebUI show PlateType = 384-well within 1 second?
Did the WebUI show IsPrimed = true within 1 second?
Did all status fields reset within 1 second after disconnect?

tests.name: Unit conversion correctness
tests.description: Set values via commands and verify the server logs show correct unit conversions.
tests.expected: Server log values = UI values x conversion factor

steps.message: Check the server log: does the SetColumnVolume call show Volume=500 (representing 50 uL in 1/10 uL units)?
Check the server log: does SetDispensingHeight show Height=1700 (representing 17mm in 1/100 mm units)?
Check the server log: does Shake show Time=500 (representing 5 seconds in 1/100 s units)?

tests.name: Error modal retry/ignore/abort
tests.description: Trigger an error in the WebUI and test the recovery modal buttons.
tests.expected: Each button works as described. Retry retries the failed step, Ignore skips it, Abort stops everything.

steps.message: In the Multidrop Combi WebUI, set the dispensing height field to an invalid value (clear the field or enter 0), then click Dispense. When the error modal appears, click 'Retry'.
Did the Retry button retry the failed operation?
Trigger the same error again. This time click 'Ignore' in the error modal.
Did Ignore skip the failed step and continue?
Trigger the same error one more time. This time click 'Abort' in the error modal.
Did Abort stop the entire workflow?

tests.name: Settings save/load persistence
tests.description: Save settings in the WebUI, change them, then load and verify persistence.
tests.expected: Settings persist across page loads via localStorage

steps.message: In the WebUI, enter a profile name (e.g., 'test-profile') and click Save.
Select the saved profile ('test-profile') and click Load.
Were the settings restored to the original values (96-well, Standard cassette, speed 75, height 20mm)?
Close the browser tab and reopen the WebUI.
Is the saved profile still available in the profile list?

tests.name: SIM/REAL badge accuracy
tests.description: Toggle simulation mode and verify the badge updates in the WebUI.
tests.expected: Badge accurately reflects current mode after each switch

steps.message: Open the Multidrop Combi WebUI. The server should be in simulation mode. Verify the 'SIM' badge is visible (blue).
Is the SIM badge visible and blue?
Did the badge change to 'REAL' (orange/red)?
Did the badge change back to 'SIM' (blue)?

categories.name: Structured Logging
categories.description: ServerLogProvider feature: structured log queries with filters

tests.name: GetLogs with no filters returns entries
tests.description: Query logs with no filters. Server should have logged startup entries.
tests.expected: Non-empty array of log entries returned

tests.name: GetLogs with MinSeverity=ERROR
tests.description: Query logs filtered to ERROR and above. All returned entries should be ERROR or CRITICAL.
tests.expected: All entries have level ERROR or CRITICAL (or empty if none)

tests.name: GetLogs with Feature=Server
tests.description: Query logs filtered to the Server feature. All returned entries should have feature 'Server'.

tests.name: GetLogs with MaxEntries=5 returns at most 5
tests.description: Query with MaxEntries=5 and verify no more than 5 entries are returned.

tests.name: GetLogFeatures returns feature list
tests.description: GetLogFeatures should return a list containing at least 'Server' (from startup logs).

tests.name: LogStats property returns valid JSON
tests.description: Read the LogStats property and verify it contains expected fields.
tests.expected: JSON with total_entries, counts_by_level, oldest_timestamp, newest_timestamp, db_size_bytes

categories.name: Script Runner — Execution
categories.description: Core script execution: output capture, exit codes, error handling, and the device helper preamble

tests.name: Simple print output
tests.description: Run a one-liner that prints 'hello' and verify it appears in FullOutput with exit code 0.

tests.name: Multi-line output
tests.description: Run a script with multiple print statements and verify all lines appear in FullOutput.

tests.name: Computation and formatted output
tests.description: Run a script that does arithmetic and string formatting, verify computed result in output.

tests.name: Standard library imports
tests.description: Verify scripts can import standard library modules (json, math, datetime).

params.ScriptCode:
import json, math, datetime
print('imports_ok')
print(json.dumps({'pi': round(math.pi, 2)}))

tests.name: Loop output
tests.description: Run a script with a for loop and verify output from each iteration.

tests.name: Syntax error produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code with a syntax error. Should complete (not crash the server) with non-zero exit code and traceback in output.

tests.name: Runtime exception produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code that raises a runtime exception. Should produce non-zero exit code with traceback.

tests.name: Empty script succeeds with exit code 0
tests.description: Run an empty (whitespace-only) script. Should succeed without error.

tests.name: FullOutput contains ScriptRunner banner
tests.description: Verify that ScriptRunner injects its own [ScriptRunner] Started and Finished banners into the output.

tests.name: Consecutive script executions
tests.description: Run two scripts back-to-back. Verify each produces independent output (no bleed-over).
tests.expected: First output contains 'first_run', second contains 'second_run' and not 'first_run'

categories.description: Verify the injected `device` helper object works: introspection, print, sleep

tests.name: device object is available
tests.description: Verify the `device` object exists and is a DeviceHelper instance.

tests.name: device.print() writes to output
tests.description: Verify device.print() sends text to the captured output stream.

tests.name: device.features lists server features
tests.description: Verify device.features returns a list that includes MultidropCombi and ScriptRunner.

tests.name: device.commands() lists feature commands
tests.description: Verify device.commands('ScriptRunner') returns known command names.

tests.name: device.properties() lists feature properties
tests.description: Verify device.properties('ScriptRunner') returns IsRunning.

tests.description: Use device.property() to read the DisplayIcon property (binary). Should not crash.

tests.description: Save a script, verify it appears in list, load it back, then delete it and verify it's gone.
